name: uk.stillrelevant/still-relevant
title: Still Relevant
description: Send a fax from your AI agent to the UK and 108 countries. Pay per fax, charged only if delivered.

tools.name: send_fax
tools.description: Prepare a fax to a fax number anywhere in the world and get a payment link for the user. £2.49 per fax within the UK and to most of Europe, the US and Canada (up to 25 pages); some countries cost more and the exact price comes back in the result. Charged only if the fax is delivered. Accepts almost any document: PDF, Word, images, text, Markdown, spreadsheets, slides. Give the file as a public https URL (file_url) or base64 (file_base64 with filename). Returns pay_url (the user must open it and pay; nothing is sent before that) and status_url. Do not open pay_url yourself.

to.description: Fax number. Include the country code ("+44 20 7946 0000") or give country. UK numbers like "020 7946 0000" work without it.

country.description: Two-letter country code of the fax number, if it has no + code. Default GB.

file_url.description: Public https URL of the document.

file_base64.description: The document as base64, if there is no URL.

filename.description: File name with extension, e.g. "letter.docx". Needed with file_base64.

tools.name: fax_status
tools.description: Check whether a fax has been paid for, is sending, was delivered (charged) or failed (not charged).
